build_metadata_from_local_shards: build metadata from local shards to create a ShardedTensorMetadata object for distributed tensor sharding
build_global_metadata: build global metadata by gathering and merging ShardedTensorMetadata from all ranks in a process group
validate_output_tensor_for_gather: validate output tensor for gather operation ensuring correct size and placement on destination rank
parse_and_validate_remote_device: parse and validate remote device placement from process group and RPC worker information
flatten_tensor_size: flatten and validate tensor size sequence returning a torch.Size object with integer dimensions
